query: Please implement a charity donation website and mini-program for collecting donations. The website and mini-program should have a donation function, allowing users to choose the donation amount and payment method, including WeChat pay and Alipay. Users should also be able to browse donation projects and donation records, and view the use of donations. Set primary background to cloud white and elements to midnight blue.
